[[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate had a '''nest-brother''', as part of [[House Sizhran]], who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bombardment of Falleen|bombardment]] of the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|homeworld]] in an effort to stop a [[flesh-eating bacterium]] from spreading out of control.
